dimension: Is an autologous transplant its own line, or part of induction?
ours: Both, depending on where it falls. Inside a line it is part of it: LOT1 allows a single AUTO and allows a tandem pair, and a later line allows an AUTO within its own induction window. Beyond that it is a boundary - the excess AUTO ends the current line with reason SCT_AUTO, and SCT_AUTO is one of the start types the next line can take, so a further transplant becomes a line of its own even with no drug beside it.
ask_the_protocol: Does the definition count ASCT as a separate prior line, or as part of the induction line it follows? Does the answer change for a transplant at second line or later?

dimension: Is an allogeneic transplant its own line?
ours: Yes, and it spans a single day - start and end are the transplant date. It carries no regimen string, because induction rows are suppressed for it.
ask_the_protocol: Is alloSCT counted as a prior line in its own right?

dimension: Is CAR-T its own line, and what happens to bridging therapy?
ours: Usually, but not inside first-line induction. A CAR-T in LOT1's induction window is part of LOT1: it does not end the line and does not start one. Anywhere else it starts a line of its own, and an agent added within the consolidation window before it is read as bridging and stays in the prior line, which ends CART_INIT.
ask_the_protocol: Is CAR-T a prior line? Is bridging therapy counted separately from it? Does a CAR-T during first-line induction count as a second line?

dimension: Is maintenance counted as a line?
ours: No. Maintenance is a descriptive flag (contains_mtx_reg) and there is no maintenance period at all. A regimen reduced to a single agent continues the same line.
ask_the_protocol: Does the definition count maintenance as part of the preceding line, or as a line of its own?

ours: A non-steroid agent that is not a permissible substitute of a drug in the current line, or a transplant or CAR-T event. There is no requirement that progression be documented - claims do not carry it.
ask_the_protocol: Does a new line require documented progression or relapse, or is any regimen change enough?

dimension: When does a gap in treatment end a line?
ours: A gap of MAP_DISCON_GAP_DAYS or more after an agent's exposure ends discontinues it. The predicate is >=, so the threshold day itself counts as a gap.
ask_the_protocol: Does the definition end a line on a treatment gap, and at what length? Are holds for toxicity excluded?

dimension: How long may an agent join a line's regimen?
ours: Day 0 through INDUCTION_WINDOW_DAYS - 1 for LOT1, and the shorter LOT-N window for later lines. An agent after that is an addition, not part of the regimen. Membership is a fill inside the window, not coverage across it: an episode that opened in the previous line and is still stockpiled into this one does not join, because a patient who has switched is no longer filling the old agent.
ask_the_protocol: Is there a window within which added agents belong to the same regimen, and how long?

dimension: Does swapping to a substitute start a line?
ours: No, where the pair is declared in permissible_subs.csv. A substitution the code list does not know about looks like a regimen change and starts a line.
ask_the_protocol: Are biosimilars, route changes or generic swaps treated as the same agent?

ours: No. Steroids are dropped from the code list, so they never start a line, never join a regimen and never keep one alive.
ask_the_protocol: Are corticosteroids counted as agents in the regimen, or disregarded?

dimension: Does a dose change or a hold start a line?
ours: No. Neither is visible as a regimen change: the agent set is unchanged, and a hold shorter than the discontinuation gap does not end exposure.
ask_the_protocol: Does the definition exclude dose modification and holds?

dimension: Is there a cap on how many lines are counted?
ours: Yes - MAX_LOT. Nothing above it is built, so a capped patient is indistinguishable from a completed one.
ask_the_protocol: Does the source cap the line count, or report the full distribution?

dimension: What fixes the start of the first line?
ours: The first eligible MM therapy claim on or after the MM diagnosis and on or after LOT1_FROM. Belantamab and steroids cannot set it. That date is the cohort index.
ask_the_protocol: How is the start of first-line therapy defined, and may any agent set it?
